test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pen is a box.

Some pens are chalks.

All chalks are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are pens.

II. Some chalks are not boxes.

III. Some boxes are not erasers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

No pen is a box.

Some pens are chalks.

All chalks are erasers.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4b9c0b9ed8089f019f6000bf3f3f60fe519aece22bee242b4a4b96d934642e1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are pens - True (Because, Those erasers that is chalks will pen also).

II. Some chalks are not boxes - True (Because, Those part of Chalks that is pen will also not boxes).

III. Some boxes are not erasers - False (__It may or may not be true cause it can also consider the part of pen which does not include eraser. So, it is indefinite conclusion__).

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
